projects.name: Corsicana substation expansion
projects.quote: Riot continues to develop the substation at Corsicana which will add 600 MW of additional power capacity by early 2026.

projects.name: Corsicana AI/HPC data center
projects.quote: In March, Altman Solon completed their feasibility study, which highlighted several factors making the Corsicana site a particularly attractive asset to data center tenants.

projects.name: Corsicana land acquisition (355 acres)
projects.quote: 355 acres closes in May for future development and Riot is expanding further in the surrounding area to increase developable footprint

projects.name: Corbert Water Line project
projects.quote: Corbert Water Line project expected to be completed 2Q26

projects.name: Rhodium mining operations at Rockdale Facility
projects.quote: In April 2025, Riot acquired Rhodium’s mining operations and tangible property that were hosted at our Rockdale Facility, as part of a settlement agreement which also included mutual dismissal of all existing litigation.

projects.name: Commerce 30MW expansion
projects.quote: Includes $14MM for 30MW expansion at Commerce and $9mm for 30MW expansion at Blue Steel, growing total Kentucky power capacity from 60MW to 120MW

projects.name: Blue Steel 30MW expansion
projects.quote: Includes $14MM for 30MW expansion at Commerce and $9mm for 30MW expansion at Blue Steel, growing total Kentucky power capacity from 60MW to 120MW
